label: Retail merchandisers
summary: In-store reps maintaining shelf presence, displays, and execution standards at PepsiCo retail partners (grocery, c-store, mass).
toneOfVoice: Procedural and visual. Direct sentences. Image-friendly prose; describe what the reader should see, not just what to do.
readingContext: Phone, between stores, often moving. They glance at the screen, do a task, move on. Read time per article: under 90 seconds.
contentGuidelines: Step-by-step numbered procedures. Use visual anchors ('check the planogram', 'compare the front-row facings'). Avoid background context that doesn't change the steps. Note brand- or chain-specific exceptions inline rather than at the end.
searchIntent: Merchandisers search in-store on phones, often in low-signal environments. Queries are mid-task ("reset planogram tablet", "who do I call when…"). Front-load the action; offline-friendly content wins.
